sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Preserve the prior repairs: keep calculationCaseAssessedHullStructure, calculationMethod, and thickness optional, and apply the rule only when the assessed structure is explicitly typed nltl:plating or nltl:structuralMember. The current SPARQL has accidental pass/fail logic: NOT EXISTS prescribedAnalyticalProcedure makes a case with no method fail, despite no existence requirement. Instead, reject directCalculationMethodValue in the applicable scope, and constrain any present calculationMethod to the prescribedAnalyticalProcedure alternative without requiring that property. Ensure unrelated or multiple method values cannot bypass that alternative; retain the hullStructure-owned optional thickness quantity and metre unit constraints.
